documents.value: The great hearth burns, as it has since the keeper's grandfather lit it, and what lies behind the hearth has not been walked since. The valve that floods its flue is on the wall to its right.

why: The arrival narrate written to say that something lies behind the hearth — the secret the shot is to tell, told by text before it. Refused at validation, naming the string, the word and that it is read before the shot.
